title: HELD IN HIS HAND
NEVER PERISH
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering
stock_queries: golden sunrise light rays through mountain pass
calm mountain lake reflecting blue sky
dramatic clouds rays of sun over vast valley
peaceful river flowing through majestic pine forest
sunbeams shining through dense forest trees
golden hour landscape towering mountain peak

scenes.a: If you fear losing your place in God's care today, listen to Jesus' promise:
And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish,
neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all;
and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.
Lord, anchor this soul in Your unbreakable grip. No trial or threat can tear them away or snatch them from Your omnipotent protection.
Guard their heart, quiet their fears, and keep them secure now and forever. Subscribe to walk under God's daily covering.
